why: More Dakka: "This unit’s ranged attacks have: [IGNORES COVER]". It is a datasheet ability (Wahapedia ABILITIES, not wargear). Core 19.04: "abilities/rules that affect a unit (or models in it) apply to every model in an attached unit"; FAQ: "A rule that applies to ’this/that unit’ … applies to all models in an attached unit". So the Meganobz' Kombi-weapon has it too, and NR prints it on the Nobz' Kombi-rokkit in the Big Mek unit. NR leaves it off the Meganobz' profiles, so the footnote is needed. It says the rule's words and nothing more. It also covers the Big Mek's two weapons, which already print it, but a keyword does not stack, so nothing is added twice. (19.04 also says it lasts only while the Big Mek is alive; the app adds that caveat nowhere for leader abilities.)

EFFECT: "When a hit roll … results in a hit, if a model in your GRETCHIN unit is on the battlefield, end the attack sequence for that attack and your GRETCHIN unit suffers 1 mortal wound." The condition covers both results. The gist puts "(if it has a model on the battlefield)" after the mortal wound only, so it reads as if hits are still stopped once the Gretchin are gone. Should be: "If a model in your GRETCHIN unit is on the battlefield, each hit roll of that enemy unit’s ranged attacks on that ORKS unit that results in a hit ends that attack, and your GRETCHIN unit suffers 1 mortal wound."

fix.gist: If a model in your GRETCHIN unit is on the battlefield, each hit roll of that enemy unit’s ranged attacks on that ORKS unit that results in a hit ends that attack, and your GRETCHIN unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
